canonical_statement: The repository source names an umbrella theory rather than one proposition. The intended classical core is provisionally scoped as follows: for a compact linear operator T on a complex Banach space, every nonzero point of the spectrum is an eigenvalue; each nonzero eigenspace is finite-dimensional; and zero is the only possible accumulation point of the spectrum. The source audit must decide whether all three clauses, and any algebraic-multiplicity or resolvent clause, belong to the exact root before the statement gate.
domain_and_universes: Provisional: a complex Banach space X and a compact continuous linear endomorphism T : X ->L[C] X; exact Lean universes and scalar generality remain open.
quantifiers: compact continuous linear endomorphism T of X
for the accumulation clause, arbitrary neighborhoods of nonzero spectral values
hypotheses: lambda is nonzero when invoking the eigenvalue and finite-dimensionality clauses
conclusion: Provisional conjunction: nonzero spectral values are eigenvalues, their eigenspaces are finite-dimensional, and the spectrum has no nonzero accumulation point.
